We believe in exploring new ideas, embracing challenges, and turning imagination into meaningful innovation. summary:
Beyond Known: Exploring the Search for Planet X

Beyond Known is an interactive astronomy website that explores one of the biggest mysteries in our solar system: the possibility of Planet X, also known as Planet Nine. The website introduces the scientific evidence behind this hypothesis, explains its predicted characteristics, and clearly distinguishes scientific estimates from confirmed discoveries.

It connects this mystery to NASA's SPHEREx mission, which maps the entire sky in 102 infrared bands. Through an interactive spectral data section, users can learn how infrared observations reveal information that ordinary visible-light images cannot show. The website also includes an educational orbit model, scientific explanations, and links to official NASA sources.

The project addresses the challenge by making astronomy and space research more accessible, engaging, and understandable to the public. It encourages users to explore scientific evidence, question the unknown, and understand how advanced space missions help us investigate the universe.

Beyond what we know, there is still more to discover.
details:
Project Details – Beyond Known

Beyond Known is an interactive educational website that explores the mystery of Planet X, also known as Planet Nine, and connects it to NASA's SPHEREx space mission.

The website works through several sections. It introduces Planet X and the scientific evidence behind its possible existence, explains its predicted orbit and distance from the Sun, and includes an interactive orbit-distance slider to help users understand how far away it could be. Another section introduces SPHEREx and its mission to map the entire sky using 102 infrared bands. The Spectral Data Lab allows visitors to explore different infrared wavelength groups and understand what scientists can learn from them. The website also provides links to official NASA sources so users can verify the information.

The main benefit is making complicated astronomical concepts easier to understand and explore. It encourages curiosity, scientific thinking, and public interest in space exploration. Its intended impact is to help students and the general public become more interested in astronomy while understanding the difference between scientific hypotheses, predictions, and confirmed discoveries.

The project was designed using Figma, which was used to create the website layout, visual design, interactive elements, and overall user experience. The design uses a dark space-inspired theme, clear sections, scientific labels, and interactive features to make the information engaging without overwhelming visitors.

The creative aspect of Beyond Known is its connection between two fascinating ideas: the search for a hypothetical distant planet and SPHEREx's exploration of the infrared universe. Instead of presenting astronomy as a collection of facts, it turns the experience into an exploration of scientific evidence and unanswered questions.
